# Benchmark point estimates

```{r benchmark_pestimate, echo=FALSE}
source("fbd.R")
results = NULL
n = 99
#n = 5
use_stored_bi = TRUE # Set to false to regenerate BI
pb = txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n, style = 3)
for(i in 0:n){
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
  attempt <- tryCatch({
    # Load data and gt tree
    simu_data = load_simu_data(file = paste("simulations_data/simulated_traditions_22_07/sequences_", i, ".nex", sep = ""), return_dates=TRUE)
    data = simu_data$data
    dates_vector = simu_data$dates_vector
    ### Then GT, without forgetting the 0-length edge conversion
    gt <- convert_gt_internal_nodes(
      file=paste("simulations_data/simulated_traditions_22_07/tree_", i, ".newick", sep = ""),
      attach = "star"
      )
  }, error = function(e) {
    # Print a warning showing which file failed
    message(sprintf("Skipping iteration %d due to error: %s", i, e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  # --- 2. Skip to next iteration if loading failed ---
  if (is.null(attempt)) {
    next
  }
  # Perform analyses
  dm <- dist.hamming(data)
  treeNJ<- NJ(dm)
  treeUNJ <- UNJ(dm)
  mm_start <- treeNJ
  # Applying the pratchet method for maximum parsimony
  # Default, fitch + SPR
  mm_tree <- pratchet(data, start = mm_start, minit = 10, maxit = 10000, all = TRUE, trace = 0, method = "fitch", rearrangements = "SPR", perturbation = "ratchet")
  # Doing MP with implied weights and concavity=3 on all enumerated trees
  data_iw = clean_phydat_attributes(data)
  iw_trees = iw_enumerate(
    data_iw, 
    3, 
    trees = TreeTools::RootTree(all_topologies(data_iw), 1))
  
  ## Maximum likelihood
  fit_mk <- pml(treeNJ, data = data)
  fit_opt_stoch <- optim.pml(
    fit_mk, 
    rearrangement = "stochastic", # Replaces deterministic optNni = TRUE
    optEdge = TRUE,     # Optimize branch lengths
    control = pml.control(trace = 0)
  )
  
  if(use_stored_bi){
    BI_mcc = ape::read.tree(file = paste("rbeast_out/mcc_", i, ".tree",  sep=""))
    BI = NULL
  } else {
    # And now bayesian FBD-based analysis
  BI = fbd(data,
           dates_vector,
           nj_init = FALSE,
           template_file =
             #"beast_templates/BDSKY_serial.xml",
             #"beast_templates/FBD_NJinit_serial.xml",
             "beast_templates/FBD_uncorrLogNorm.xml",
           out = 
             paste("rbeast_out/", "sequences_", i, sep=""),
           chain_length=10000000, 
           bin_folder = beast_bin_folder)
  BI_mcc = BI$mcc_tree
  }
  
  ## Now score everything
  preds <- list(NJ       = treeNJ,
                UNJ      = treeUNJ,
                MP_SC    = ape::consensus(mm_tree, p = 1),
                IW_k3   = ape::consensus(iw_trees, p=1),
                #MP_mean     = mm_tree,
                ML        = fit_opt_stoch$tree,
                FBD_MCC   = BI_mcc##,
                #FBD_MRC   = BI$mrc_tree
  )
  # And now results
  results <- rbind(results, score_methods(preds, gt, tradition = i))
  
  if(!is.null(BI)){
    # save objects to disk
    write.tree(BI$mrc_tree, file=paste("rbeast_out/mrc_", i, ".tree", sep=""))
    write.tree(BI$mcc_tree, file=paste("rbeast_out/mcc_", i, ".tree", sep=""))
  }
  # save objects to disk
  write.tree(fit_opt_stoch$tree, file=paste("ml_out/", i, ".tree", sep=""))
  
}
write.csv(results, "results.csv")
```

# Benchmark bootstrapped methods

```{r phyloFunc}
nj_fun <- function(x) {
    dm <- dist.hamming(x)
    NJ(dm)
  }
unj_fun <- function(x) {
    dm <- dist.hamming(x)
    UNJ(dm)
}
mp_fun <- function(x) {
  mm_start <- NJ(dist.hamming(x))
  trees = pratchet(x, start = mm_start, minit = 10, maxit = 10000, all = TRUE, trace = 0, method = "fitch", rearrangements = "SPR", perturbation = "ratchet")
  if (inherits(trees, "multiPhylo")) {
    trees <- ape::consensus(trees, p = 1)
  }
  trees
}
```

```{r benchmark_bs, echo=FALSE}
set.seed(123)
results_bs = NULL
n = 99
#n = 5
pb = txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n, style = 3)
for(i in 0:n){
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
  attempt <- tryCatch({
    simu_data = load_simu_data(file = paste("simulations_data/simulated_traditions_22_07/sequences_", i, ".nex", sep = ""), return_dates=TRUE)
    data = simu_data$data
    dates_vector = simu_data$dates_vector
    ### Then GT, without forgetting the 0-length edge conversion
    gt <- convert_gt_internal_nodes(
      paste("simulations_data/simulated_traditions_22_07/tree_", i, ".newick", sep = ""),
      attach = "star"
      )
  }, error = function(e) {
    # Print a warning showing which file failed
    message(sprintf("Skipping iteration %d due to error: %s", i, e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  # --- 2. Skip to next iteration if loading failed ---
  if (is.null(attempt)) {
    next
  }
  # Perform BS analyses
  ### DISTANCE BASED
  nj_bootstraps <- bootstrap.phyDat(data, FUN = nj_fun, bs = 100)
  treeNJ = ape::consensus(nj_bootstraps, p = 0.5)
  unj_bootstraps <- bootstrap.phyDat(data, FUN = unj_fun, bs = 100)
  treeUNJ <- ape::consensus(unj_bootstraps, p = 0.5)
  
  ### Maximum parsimony
  bs_trees <- bootstrap.phyDat(data, FUN = mp_fun, bs = 100)
  mm_tree <- ape::consensus(bs_trees, p = 0.5)
  
  ## Maximum likelihood
  fit_mk <- pml(NJ(dist.hamming(data)), data = data)
  fit_opt_NNI <- optim.pml(
    fit_mk, 
    optNni = TRUE,
    optEdge = TRUE,
    control = pml.control(trace = 0)
  )
  bs_trees_nni <- bootstrap.pml(
    fit_opt_NNI, 
    bs = 100, 
    multicore = TRUE,
    optNni = TRUE
  )
  fit_opt_NNIBS = ape::consensus(bs_trees_nni, p = 0.5)
  ## And load FBD MRC
  mrc_file <- paste0("rbeast_out/mrc_", i, ".tree")
  fbd_mrc  <- if (file.exists(mrc_file)) ape::read.tree(mrc_file) else NULL
  ## Now score everything
  preds <- list(NJ_BS       = treeNJ,
                UNJ_BS      = treeUNJ,
                MP_BS       = mm_tree,
                ML_BS       = fit_opt_NNIBS,
                FBD_MRC     = fbd_mrc
  )
  results_bs <- rbind(results_bs, score_methods(preds, gt, tradition = i))
}
write.csv(results_bs, "results_bs.csv")
```


# Final figure

```{r finalFig}
custom_methods = c(
  NJ      = "NJ",
  UNJ     = "UNJ",
  MP_SC   = "MP-EW",
  IW_k3   = "MP-IW",
  ML      = "ML",
  FBD_MCC = "BI",
  NJ_BS   = "NJ",
  UNJ_BS  = "UNJ",
  MP_BS   = "MP-EW",
  ML_BS   = "ML",
  FBD_MRC = "BI"
)
library("patchwork")
pA = plot_metric_boxplots(results, "quartet_div", 
                          ylab = "quartet  divergence", 
                          title = "", 
                          methods = custom_methods)
pB = plot_metric_boxplots(results_bs, "quartet_div", 
                          ylab = "quartet  divergence", 
                          title = "", 
                          methods = custom_methods)
pC = plot_metric_boxplots(results, "cid", 
                          ylab = "igRF  dissimilarity", 
                          title = "", 
                          methods = custom_methods)
pD = plot_metric_boxplots(results_bs, "cid", 
                          ylab = "igRF  dissimilarity", 
                          title = "", 
                          methods = default_methods)
pE = plot_accuracy_resolution(results, 
                              methods = custom_methods)
pF = plot_accuracy_resolution(results_bs, 
                              methods = custom_methods)
figure_6panel <- wrap_plots(
  pA, pB,
  pC, pD,
  pE, pF,
  ncol = 2,
  nrow = 3
) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, nrow = 3) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 1.5)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold") # A-F
  )
figure_6panel
ggsave("six_panel_figure.png", figure_6panel, width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 300) 
```
